lines.speaker: Arin
lines.text: I remember the route. I remember the rain. Why can't I remember the face?

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: Because memory is not the same as a record. Find what was written about you.

lines.speaker: Arin
lines.text: Am I dead?

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: Your body is. Your unfinished account is not.

lines.speaker: Marek
lines.text: Your route code was on the order. You helped them reach my sister.

lines.speaker: Arin
lines.text: I planned deliveries. I never approved that operation.

lines.speaker: Marek
lines.text: The contract names you. That's enough.

lines.speaker: Arin
lines.text: Then look at the original dispatch sheet. Someone changed the names.

lines.speaker: Marek
lines.text: If they lied to me, I still chose what I did. Don't call that justice.

lines.speaker: Silas
lines.text: People call it a maze when they cannot see the pattern.

lines.speaker: Arin
lines.text: You wrote the pattern. You changed Marek's contract.

lines.speaker: Silas
lines.text: I corrected a useful man's aim. The Warden's rules are older than its conscience.

lines.speaker: Arin
lines.text: The proxy clause says the choice must be free.

lines.speaker: Silas
lines.text: Correct. A secret is not consent. Remember that when you ask someone to save you.

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: A proxy must know the whole record and choose without threat.

lines.speaker: Arin
lines.text: If Dev acts, I return?

lines.speaker: Warden
lines.text: If he acts freely to close the forged contract, yes. I cannot make him choose.

lines.speaker: Arin
lines.text: Then send him the evidence. Let him decide with the truth this time.

lines.speaker: Dev
lines.text: I told myself I was buying time for my family. Then I saw the ledger and thought I could bury everything.

lines.speaker: Arin
lines.text: You could have told me. You could have walked away.

lines.speaker: Dev
lines.text: I was afraid you'd expose me with the others. I chose to kill you. That part was mine.

lines.speaker: Arin
lines.text: And the fire?

lines.speaker: Dev
lines.text: I tried to burn the records. The door jammed. I died with the truth I was trying to destroy.

lines.speaker: Arin
lines.text: The truth goes out. Your choice stays yours.
